title: Booking Expedited Shipping Fees on Home Delivery Pharmacy Orders
content:
## Desk reference: expedited shipping fees on the most recent shipment

**When it applies.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, when the account's most recent shipment went out by an expedited method the member asked for and no expedited fee is booked on that order, the missing fee is booked now as one separate charge on that order.

**What it governs.** The amount of one expedited shipping-fee charge on that order. Once booked, the charge stands against the order and is added to the account's balance due, so the member owes that much more and the charge appears with the order and on the next balance statement.

### Capability

`book_expedited_fee_b4b37c53` books an expedited shipping fee on one home delivery order of a member's Northbridge Rx Home Delivery account. One call records one shipping-fee charge against the named order, dated today, and adds the fee to the account's balance due.

### How it is invoked

The tool is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `book_expedited_fee_b4b37c53`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `mail_account_id` | the reference number of the member's home delivery account the fee is booked on, as returned by the home delivery account lookup | identifier |
| `source_order_id` | the reference number of the placed order the fee belongs to (the order reference that the shipment record of that order carries), as returned by the home delivery order lookup | identifier |
| `shipping_method` | the service the fee is for | one of `two_day` (two-day delivery of the order), `overnight` (overnight delivery of the order), `standard` (the program's standard ground delivery), `cold_chain` (refrigerated cold-chain packaging and carrier) |
| `shipping_fee` | the fee amount charged to the member | USD, a non-negative number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent by the caller |

### Return

A successful call returns `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of the new shipping-fee charge on the order), `source_order_id` (the order the fee was booked on), `shipping_method` (the service recorded), `shipping_fee` (the fee booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `balance_due` (the account's balance due after the fee, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` "booked", meaning the charge now stands on the account.

### Hypothetical illustration

Call with an account reference, the order reference of the most recent shipment, `overnight` and 9.95: the receipt shows a new fee entry reference, the same order reference, `overnight`, 9.95, the balance due raised by 9.95 and status "booked".
